releases.name: Version 1.1.0
releases.body:
### Achievements Update
- Added 6 achievements (for Achievements+)
- Added Ernesto and Geswaldo
    - Geswaldo has stuff for you to mess around with after beating the mod...
releases.bodyZh:
### 成就更新
- 添加了6个成就（用于成就+）
- 添加了Ernesto和Geswaldo
    - Geswaldo在击败模组后...有东西让你捣鼓

releases.name: Version 1.0.8
releases.body:
Update for compatibility with an upcoming update to Jam Hub
(Adds a flag in save data for if you've beat Core Collapse. If you already have, just resume expedition once with this mod enabled to update the flag.)
releases.bodyZh:
更新以兼容即将到来的 Jam Hub 更新
（在存档数据中添加一个标记，用于显示你是否已经通关了核心坍缩。如果你已经通关了，只需启用此模组后重新开始一次探险即可更新该标记。）

releases.name: Version 1.0.7
releases.body:
- Campfires can hopefully no longer send you to space
- Campfires can hopefully no longer burn you after sleeping for a long time
